progression.narrative: The performance opens on Fs4 and dwells most on Fs in Zarbi-ye Mokhalef. The line peaks at Fs4 (370.6 Hz) at 2:08.0. It closes on D4, not the tonic (D4 → E4 → E4 → E4 → E4 → D4).

flags: tonic A set in the catalog (Chahargah's finalis A (225.6 Hz; the suite's other nine tracks voted it). The vote picked the 4th above; Mokhalef has a finalis of its own, the 6th above Chahargah's (Farhat 1990, p. 60). Inference, not yet by ear); the runs' vote favoured 299.8 Hz (D)
